faqs.q: How long does delivery take across Sri Lanka?
faqs.a: We dispatch all orders via prompt courier services. Deliveries to Western Province take 1-2 business days, and all other 24 districts take 2-3 business days. Cash on Delivery is available islandwide.

faqs.q: Are EECO incense sticks and powders 100% natural and non-toxic?
faqs.a: Yes! All EECO Aromatics products are handcrafted in Sri Lanka using pure Ayurvedic resins, natural herbs, essential oils, and botanical wood powders without harmful synthetic charcoal or heavy chemicals.

faqs.q: Can I order directly through WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Absolutely! You can click any WhatsApp button across our website or message our hotline at 076 205 1906 with your desired items and delivery address for instant confirmation.

faqs.q: Do you offer Wholesale and Bulk Supply for shops or temples?
faqs.a: Yes, we supply bulk wholesale cartons to retailers, spiritual centers, Ayurvedic spas, and hotels across Sri Lanka at special discounted trade rates. Contact us on WhatsApp for catalog and quotes.
